segments.caption: The frames display a static logo reveal for the brand Vétoquinol, beginning with a blank screen and progressively adding the brand's green logo, its tagline “a Sign of Passion,” and its website address, “www.vetoquinolusa.com,” to form a complete branded presentation.

This segment introduces a Vétoquinol instructional guide on how to clean a dog’s ears. It begins with the brand’s logo and tagline, “a Sign of Passion,” establishing the source. The main event is then clearly stated with the title “How to... Clean Your Dog’s Ears,” followed by the visual presentation of the specific product—the Vétoquinol Ear Cleansing Solution—used for the task.

A veterinarian, Dr. Wesley Williams, kneels on the floor in a clinic room, gently holding a golden retriever as he prepares to demonstrate how to clean a dog’s ears using a bottle of Vetoquinol Ear Cleansing Solution.

A veterinarian in a white coat kneels on the floor of a clinic, gently holding a golden retriever. He appears to be examining or comforting the dog, which at one point yawns widely. The scene remains consistent across the frames, with a small bottle visible on the floor nearby, and the veterinarian’s focused attention on the dog indicating a routine check-up or a moment of care.

A veterinarian kneels on the floor in a clinic hallway, gently holding a calm golden retriever while demonstrating the use of a small bottle, likely a topical treatment, before placing it down on the floor.

A veterinarian in a white coat kneels on the floor in a clinical setting, gently holding and comforting a golden retriever. The dog, initially calm, turns its head and looks around as the man speaks to the camera, with a small bottle of Vetoquinol product visible on the floor nearby.

A veterinarian and an assistant kneel beside a calm golden retriever in a veterinary clinic, with a bottle of Vetoquinol ear cleaning solution on the floor nearby, setting the stage for a demonstration on how to clean a dog's ears.

In a veterinary clinic, a golden retriever sits calmly between a male and female veterinarian as they prepare to examine its ears. The male vet kneels beside the dog, while the female vet gently holds its head. The camera then zooms in as the female vet carefully lifts the dog's ear flap to inspect its inner ear, with the male vet’s hand also assisting to keep the dog still, demonstrating a routine and gentle veterinary ear check.
A person gently holds and examines the ear of a golden retriever, using their fingers to carefully inspect the inner flap and surrounding fur, while another person steadies the dog’s head.

A veterinarian and a veterinary technician gently examine the ear of a calm golden retriever in a clinic, with the vet holding the dog's head steady while the technician carefully inspects the ear canal.

In a veterinary clinic, a male veterinarian in a white coat crouches beside a calm, golden retriever, while a female veterinary technician in blue scrubs kneels behind the dog to gently restrain it. The vet is preparing a small white bottle, likely containing a medication or supplement, and then carefully administers a dose to the dog’s mouth. The dog remains cooperative and relaxed throughout the procedure, indicating a routine and gentle treatment.

In a veterinary clinic, a veterinarian and a veterinary technician work together to clean the ears of a calm golden retriever, demonstrating a professional pet care procedure. The scene is followed by a set of instructional tips for dog owners on how to safely clean their dog's ears at home, emphasizing key safety precautions like not inserting objects deep into the ear canal and seeking veterinary care for suspected infections.

A veterinarian in a white coat holds up a bottle of ear cleaning solution while standing in front of blinds, presenting a set of four safety tips for cleaning a dog's ears, which are displayed as text on screen.

A veterinarian, Dr. Wesley Williams of Hillside Veterinary Clinic in Dallas, TX, is featured presenting a bottle of VET Solutions Ear Cleansing Solution by Vetoquinol. The segment concludes with a credit screen acknowledging his contribution.

The segment displays a static product advertisement for Vetoquinol’s VET Solutions Ear Cleansing Solution, shown alongside its branding. The main event is the presentation of the white, dropper-top bottle labeled for dogs and cats, positioned next to the product’s promotional text. The scene context is consistent across frames, emphasizing the brand identity with the tagline “a Sign of Passion” and the website, reinforcing the product’s veterinary origin and care focus. No actions or scene changes

The frames display a static, unchanging logo for the brand Vétoquinol, featuring its name, the tagline "a Sign of Passion," a stylized sunburst icon with a wolf's face, and the website address www.vetoquinolusa.com, all presented in green text on a white background. There are no actions, scene changes, or events occurring across the frames.
